migration.title: 1:1 Migration
migration.subtitle: Convert your old Daimon into new DMN, one to one. Old tokens go to the DAO treasury.
migration.closed: The migration window closed on {date}. Migrating from this page is no longer possible: contact the DAO community for available options.
migration.treasuryWarning: ⚠ The connected wallet is the DAO treasury, i.e. the destination of the old tokens: it cannot migrate itself (the contract would reject the operation). Connect a different wallet to try the migration.
migration.detected: Old Daimon detected in the wallet:
migration.connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to detect your old Daimon.
migration.insufficient: The amount exceeds the old Daimon available{balance}: reduce it to proceed.
migration.receiveSuffix: — 1 DMX → 1 DMN, token for token, no fee (only network gas). 1:1 is a count, not a price.
migration.opensShortly: The contracts are live; one last launch step, which lets old Daimon reach the DAO treasury without fees, is still to come. Until then every migration would fail, so this page will not send one. There is nothing to do: your old Daimon stay in your wallet, and this page unlocks by itself when the window opens.
migration.checkingOpen: Checking on chain whether the migration is open…
migration.capExceeded: The old token allows at most {cap} per transaction: migrate in several steps of {cap} at most.
migration.invalidAmount: This amount can't be read. Write it like this: {example}.

terms.title: Before you continue
terms.intro: This dApp is an interface to smart contracts on BNB Smart Chain. Here is what you are agreeing to, in plain words.
terms.p1: Daimon is open-source software provided "as is", without warranties. Smart contracts can contain defects: an audit reduces the risk, it does not eliminate it.
terms.p2: Nothing here is an offer, a solicitation, or financial, legal or tax advice. No one sells DMN, and no company operates the protocol.
terms.p3Title: No one can reverse a transaction.
terms.p3: You interact directly with a public blockchain, and every transaction is final: not the contributors, not the DAO, no one can undo or refund it. Digital assets can lose all their value.
terms.p4: The interface does not restrict access by location. By accepting, you confirm that using it is lawful where you are, and that you are not subject to sanctions (UN, EU, US OFAC, UK or equivalent).
terms.authoritative: The English text is the only authoritative version.
terms.storage: Your acceptance is saved only in this browser, with the terms version: no cookie, no tracking, nothing sent anywhere. You will be asked again if the terms change.
